content.value_statement: Next.js teams can struggle to choose routes, components, data loading, and migration steps. This skill gives structured architecture guidance for App Router, Server Components, and performance.
actual_capabilities: Designs App Router folder structures for authenticated, dashboard, and API areas.
Guides migration from Pages Router to App Router layouts and pages.
Recommends Server Component and Client Component boundaries.
Suggests performance strategies such as static generation, ISR, streaming, images, and code splitting.
Applies production-focused Next.js architecture best practices.
limitations: Does not inspect a live repository unless the host agent provides project files.
Does not execute migrations, install packages, or run build commands by itself.
Guidance may need adjustment for current Next.js releases and project constraints.
Does not replace security, accessibility, or production performance testing.

use_cases.title: Design a New Product Architecture
use_cases.description: Create a Next.js App Router structure with route groups, layouts, API routes, and data loading choices.

use_cases.title: Plan a Router Migration
use_cases.description: Convert Pages Router concepts into App Router layouts, pages, and server-first data patterns.

use_cases.title: Review Production Readiness
use_cases.description: Evaluate component boundaries, rendering modes, streaming, image handling, and code splitting before release.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a New App Router Project
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the nextjs-architecture skill to design an App Router structure for a [type] app with [features]. Include route groups, layouts, and data loading guidance.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner planning for a new Next.js application

prompt_templates.title: Choose Component Boundaries
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this feature plan and recommend Server Components, Client Components, Suspense boundaries, and data fetching patterns.

prompt_templates.title: Migrate Pages Router
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze this Pages Router structure and create a phased migration plan to App Router. Include layout conversion, route mapping, and risk checks.

prompt_templates.title: Optimize Production Architecture
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit this Next.js architecture for performance and scalability. Recommend static generation, ISR, streaming, caching, image strategy, and code splitting improvements.

output_examples.input: Migrate a user dashboard from Pages Router to App Router.
output_examples.output: A phased migration plan with route mapping, layout changes, Server Component guidance, validation steps, and release risks.

output_examples.input: Design a new application with authentication, dashboards, and API routes.
output_examples.output: An App Router folder strategy with route groups, shared layouts, API boundaries, and recommended rendering choices.

output_examples.input: Review a slow Next.js feature before production launch.
output_examples.output: A performance review covering static generation, ISR, streaming, image optimization, code splitting, and component boundaries.

best_practices: Provide current route structure, key pages, data sources, and auth requirements.
Ask for migration risks, fallback plans, and validation checks when changing routers.
Validate recommendations against the exact Next.js version and deployment platform.
anti_patterns: Asking for a full architecture without sharing routes, data needs, or constraints.
Applying Client Components broadly when Server Components satisfy the feature.
Treating generated migration steps as complete without testing build, routing, and performance.

faq.question: Does this skill write Next.js code?
faq.answer: It can suggest code patterns when the host agent asks, but its main purpose is architecture guidance.

faq.question: Can it migrate an entire repository automatically?
faq.answer: No. It can create a migration plan and guide changes when repository files are provided.

faq.question: Does it support the App Router?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill focuses on App Router structure, layouts, route groups, and Server Components.

faq.question: Can it help with Server Components?
faq.answer: Yes. It recommends when to use Server Components, Client Components, Suspense, and server-first data access.

faq.question: Does it cover performance optimization?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers static generation, ISR, streaming, image optimization, and code splitting.

faq.question: Which AI tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
